From: Lucas Chen <lucas@waypoint.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Rogers <ava@waypoint.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick eval request — Hosted API + sandbox access

Hi Rishi —

We just spun up a trial through the hosted API (signed up today) and are hoping to do a short evaluation next week focused on customer-support summarization and reranking. Would you be able to run a 30-minute walkthrough of the Hosted API and give us a quick sandbox session where our engineers can run a few prompts against a sample dataset?

High level:
- Use case: multi-channel support ticket summarization + priority rerank
- Team: myself (product) + Ava Rogers (eng lead) — possible follow-up with two ML engineers
- Must-have for evaluation: ephemeral API key for sandbox, example prompts, and a short pre-demo connectivity check so our infra people can ensure ports/KMS access (if any) are OK

Preferred windows next week (PST): Aug 6 AM or Aug 7 PM — but we can be flexible.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround,
Lucas
Lucas Chen
Product Manager, Waypoint AI

Thanks for the note, Lucas — happy to help. Two quick calls-to-action so we can make the 30 minutes high value: 1) a 15-minute sandbox pre-check to validate access/roles and 2) a short prework doc (attached) that helps us tailor the walkthrough (data shapes, expected token volumes).

I can run the demo or hand it to Dylan (our PLG demos). Proposed slots (PDT):
- Fri Aug 6, 10:00–10:30 AM
- Mon Aug 9, 3:00–3:30 PM
If those don't work, tell me two windows that do and we'll adjust.

For the sandbox pre-check I can schedule a 15-minute window the same day as the demo (we usually do it 30–60 minutes beforehand). I've attached the prework (waypoint-prework.pdf) and a sample quickstart list.

Soojin — can you provision an ephemeral sandbox session for Waypoint (link + one-time API key) and attach the .ics once ready? Dylan — I'll hand the demo to you if you're available; if not, I can lead it.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
SDR, Redwood Inference
